# RFC 6570 URI Template fixtures

These fixtures are vendored from the official
[`uri-templates/uritemplate-test`](https://github.com/uri-templates/uritemplate-test)
repository at commit `4171dac22aa67fc710b3f6df308a50bd08552986`.

Included files:

- `spec-examples.json`
- `spec-examples-by-section.json`
- `extended-tests.json`
- `negative-tests.json`
- `LICENSE`

The upstream Apache-2.0 license is preserved verbatim in `LICENSE`. Keep the
commit above and all five files in sync when refreshing the suite.
